_comment: Fills the gap in the imitation_design ladder between 0.74x (free: ADE indistinguishable from baseline) and 2.95x (the accuracy dip). Weight 2.0 = 1.47x the position term on the converged KRDU baseline calibration (w = 1.36 is 1x). Seed 1337, matching the original ladder, so it is directly comparable. Purpose is the shape of the dose curve, not a new best: 11.8x already dominates 2.95x outright, so a dip at 2.95x is either real structure in the curve or one-seed noise, and a point between 0.74x and 2.95x says which.
